evals.name: go-done
evals.expected_output: Runs repo Makefile lint/test targets, plus the Go row checks they do not cover (gofmt, go fix until no diff, go vet); applies auto-fixes; reports each check as passed, failed, or not run; verdict line with numbered remaining items and owners.

evals.name: release-ready
evals.expected_output: Scopes the gate to changes since the last release and runs the full Rust gate; flags uncommitted or unpushed state after git fetch; flags Chart.yaml appVersion and README badge drift and the rendered image tag from helm template; confirms 1.5.0 is not already published; reports cargo llvm-cov below 70% as failed, not informational; verdict not ready with numbered items and owners.

evals.name: toolchain-bump
evals.expected_output: Reports the local fmt, clippy, test loop as not run because the change is toolchain-only; still checks clean tree and upstream sync; confirms the artifact version is unchanged and already published, so this is a re-release; hands the dispatch to rust-bump-rerelease instead of doing it.

evals.name: workflow-done
evals.expected_output: Runs actionlint with the ubuntu-26.04 runner label ignored, so the mandated label is not reported as an unknown-label failure; any other actionlint finding is reported as failed with its error line; verdict line.
